prompts.sea:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image is the LOCKED rank5 world and composition. Edit ONLY the exposed grey gravel and water ON TOP OF THE WHITE CIRCULAR DISK, OUTSIDE THE SHELL ISLAND, to create a larger surrounding miniature SEA.
Keep every island feature and its exact pixel position/scale: all houses, paths, bridge, lighthouse, trees, chimneys, waterwheel, waterfall ribbons, island silhouette/rock shore, inner lagoon, pier and the existing empty rowboat. Do not redraw/rearrange/enlarge/shrink the island. Preserve the exact elevated camera, portrait canvas, white seamless background, white circular platform front thickness/bevel, clean white rim and soft contact shadow.
Replace the broad grey gravel apron outside the island with calm blue-teal sea, spreading as far as possible on the disk top while leaving a narrow clean white rim. Especially expand the open SEA IN FRONT of the island, LEFT and RIGHT, make the island surrounded by water rather than a puddle on a gravel patch. Give this outer sea a slightly deeper blue-green tone, subtle surface reflections and tiny shoreline wavelets in the SAME muted pixel-painted lofi style as the lagoon. Keep the water finite and entirely inside the white disk. No infinite ocean, sky or horizon. No glass walls. Leave clear open outer sea for a small moving boat to be animated later. No new boats or characters in this still. No UI/text/watermark. No changes to the island.
prompts.people:
Use case: compositing.
Asset: ONE landscape TRANSPARENT SPRITE SHEET containing three separate tiny background people to composite into the reference miniature harbor. Reference image is STYLE AND CAMERA ONLY, not a background.
Make three equal-width columns with generous clear alpha gaps. Exactly one complete person in each column, all same soft pixel-painted muted lofi style, no outlines, no chibi or realistic portrait. Slight elevated three-quarter camera matching the reference. Characters ultimately only 25-35px tall in a1070px world, simple readable natural anatomy and blocky color clusters.
LEFT COLUMN: one relaxed adult wearing muted slate-blue long-sleeve shirt, tan trousers, short dark hair, no hat. Full body standing with weight on one leg, upper body leaning forward, forearms resting on an INVISIBLE waist-high bridge railing, head looking out toward lower-right/lagoon. Both arms connected; no actual railing/furniture in asset.
CENTER COLUMN: one young child, simple muted ochre top and charcoal shorts, dark short hair, full body turned RIGHT, hands gently extended forward as if tossing a small ball, knees slightly bent, playful natural pose.
RIGHT COLUMN: one young child, muted dusty red top and navy shorts, dark hair, full body turned LEFT, arms forward to catch a ball, one knee slightly raised, lively but compact pose.
Do NOT draw an actual ball, bridge, ground, shadow patch, chair, text, labels, grid or background. Only these three isolated people with genuine transparent alpha. Keep all limbs intact and figures separated into their own thirds, not touching or overlapping. Adult slightly taller than the two children; keep entire figures within their columns with narrow top/bottom margins. No extra people.
prompts.ship:
Use case: compositing.
Asset: one TRANSPARENT small coastal boat cutout for the reference miniature harbor world. Reference is STYLE, LIGHTING AND ELEVATED CAMERA ONLY.
Create ONLY ONE small quaint working boat, seen from the same elevated three-quarter angle as the rowboat in the reference, bow pointing RIGHT, long axis almost horizontal (slightly diagonal, no extreme perspective). Dark weathered muted navy/wood hull, small cream cabin with a tan low roof, tiny dark windows, modest short mast and simple rope details. Compact and charming but grounded, no sail, no flags/text/logo, no visible people. It will be about65px wide in a1070px image, so use readable simple pixel-painted color clusters and subdued blue-purple shadows with warm highlights, same lofi art style as reference. Not a glossy3D toy, not vector/cartoon icon or photoreal photo. No thick outlines. Show complete boat silhouette, with entire hull visible.
ACTUAL TRANSPARENT background, narrow alpha margin. No water, wake, scenery, dock, shadow ellipse, labels or watermark. Do not copy any part of the island into the output.

shipCleanupPrompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit this boat cutout ONLY to remove ALL halo, glow, mist, drop shadow, colored light spill and backdrop around the boat. Keep the boat's exact silhouette, details and pixel-painted style intact. Produce a truly clean transparent alpha cutout: ONLY hull, cabin, mast and ropes. Pixels outside those physical parts must have alpha zero, including between the mast ropes. No ambient glow or shadows in the output. Boat lighting should be subdued soft daylight, not luminous; unlit windows. No water or background. Keep complete boat with narrow transparent margin.
